title: Sales/CS Voice-of-Customer Funnel and Initial Scoping Pipeline
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable, low-latency funnel that turns Sales/CS customer asks (non-bug enterprise feature requests) into a standardized scoping artifact for PM + Eng review. Current problem: tickets arrive as ad-hoc emails/Slack threads and consume PM/SE time without consistent prioritization signals. Goal: reduce first-response time to 48 hours, produce a one-page scope with prioritized next steps, and increase high-quality handoffs to Engineering by 3x.
triage_rubric: Axes: Value (revenue/retain/land), Regulatory risk (compliance/data residency), Customer concentration (# of customers asking), Implementation effort (engineering hours), Strategic alignment (OKR fit). Scoring: each axis 0-5; sum -> tier mapping: 18-25 = Tier A (fast-track), 12-17 = Tier B (planned roadmap), 6-11 = Tier C (customer-sourced backlog), 0-5 = Tier D (decline/document). Add 'blocking' flags for security/regulatory that force immediate seeds for Private/Enterprise track.
aggregation_workflow: 1) Sales/CS creates intake using shared template (CS Miro/Drive wizard). 2) Intake bot (Slack/Google Form) posts to #pm-intake channel. 3) PM triage within 48h using triage_rubric and fills 'one-pager' stub. 4) Weekly intake sync for cross-customer duplicates and patterns; consolidate similar requests and update CRM with aggregation notes. 5) Hand off Tier A/B items to engineering with a scoped PRD stub + feasibility questions.
scoring_algorithm: Numeric implementation: value = min(5, round(log10(ARR + 1) * 1.5)), customer_count = min(5, distinct_customers_with_same_ask), effort = engineer_estimate_score (0-5 mapped from <=2w ->1, 2-4w->2, 1-3mo->3, 3-6mo->4, >6mo->5). Regulatory flag adds +3 to priority multiplier. Final score = value*2 + customer_count*1.5 - effort*1.2 + strategic_alignment*1.8 + regulatory_bonus. Normalize and map to tiers per triage_rubric.
handoff_artifacts: Minimum deliverables to send to Eng: 1) One-page scope (problem, success metrics, non-functional constraints) 2) Consolidation note (list of customers asking + approximate ARR impact) 3) Proposed MVE or canary approach 4) Top 5 open engineering questions 5) Suggested release window and rollout plan (canary customers)
engineering_questions: Estimated engineering FTE and infra cost (ops/GPU/DB)?,
Is there an existing model/endpoint we can extend or does this require new model capabilities?
Backward compatibility / migration path for existing customers?
acceptance_criteria: - Intake template completed and attached to ticket. - Tier assigned and documented with numeric score. - One-pager produced for Tier A/B within 72 hours. - Engineering feasibility questions listed and assigned. - CRM updated with aggregation tag and customer count.
rollout_criteria: Rollout allowed when: feature passes internal QA, monitoring emits no critical regressions in 2-week canary, stakeholders sign-off, and legal/compliance sign-off for any regulatory constraints.
notes: Prototype the intake form as a Google Form + Zapier -> Linear ticket; parallel experiment with Slack slash command. Track time-to-first-scope and percent of intakes that produce an engineering-ready artifact within 7 days.
decisions: Use a single unified template across Sales/CS to minimize cognitive load. Prioritize automation for posting and scoring; initial scoring will be manual with a plan to automate in Q3. Aggregation will favor consolidation by use-case rather than by customer to highlight vertical demand.
next_steps: 1) Build Google Form + Slack integration (owned by Solutions Eng) - target 2 weeks. 2) Run 4-week pilot with top 10 enterprise customers. 3) Measure SLAs: 48h triage, 72h one-pager for Tier A/B. 4) Iterate scoring weights after pilot. 5) Add automated score calculation in Linear (PM tooling scope).
